metadata.title: Prompt Lens - AI Video Prompt Analyzer
metadata.description: Upload a video or image and let AI analyze the visual content to generate precise prompts

home.heroTitle: Turn any AI video into a prompt
home.heroSubtitle: The prompt intelligence layer that keeps your videos consistent. Go from any video or audio reference to a polished prompt in seconds.
home.promptDemoPlaceholder: Paste a video link, or describe what you want to analyze...
home.promptDemoHint: Type any video idea and AI will craft a professional prompt for you
home.featuresSubtitle: From analysis to generation, audio to editing — the full AI video workflow
home.featureAnalyzeTitle: Extract prompts from any AI video
home.featureAnalyzeDesc: Upload any AI-generated video or reference clip and Prompt Lens extracts keyframes, scene structure, and visual style into reusable structured prompts.
home.featureAnalyzeBullet1: Auto-detect shot changes, subject motion, and lighting mood
home.featureAnalyzeBullet2: Outputs complete prompts with style, aspect ratio, and motion
home.featureAnalyzeBullet3: Supports MP4, MOV, WebM, and other mainstream formats
home.featureGenTitle: Generate AI videos from a single prompt
home.featureGenDesc: Go from prompt to AI video in one click. Generate 5–15 second creative clips in multiple aspect ratios and styles.
home.featureGenBullet1: Integrates Kie.ai Sora 2 for high-quality video generation
home.featureGenBullet3: Reuse analysis results as prompts for a closed creative loop
home.featureAudioTitle: Decode audio references into visual prompts
home.featureAudioDesc: Automatically transcribe speech and segment intelligently. Extract dialogue, rhythm, and key content to turn audio references into actionable visual prompts.
home.featureAudioBullet1: Smart speech recognition and speaker segmentation
home.featureAudioBullet2: Extracts emotion, rhythm, and keywords for generation
home.featureAudioBullet3: Supports multilingual audio and background music analysis
home.featureEditTitle: Edit AI video with prompt-driven precision
home.featureEditDesc: Describe your edit intent in natural language, and AI handles clip stitching, transitions, smart music, and color presets. Editing becomes as simple as describing it.
home.featureEditBullet2: Supports fade, dissolve, wipe, and more transitions
home.featureEditBullet3: Auto music matching and cinematic color presets
home.advantagesSubtitle: A one-stop prompt workspace built for AI video creators
home.advantage1Desc: A unified analysis framework ensures every output follows the same structure for easy reuse and team collaboration.
home.advantage2Desc: Move quickly from reference to prompt to final video, validating ideas in minutes instead of hours.
home.advantage3Desc: Supports video, image, audio, and URL references to fit however you work.
home.advantage4Desc: Lock in brand style with custom prompt templates and parameters for consistent visual output.
home.howItWorksTitle: How to analyze AI video from a prompt
home.howItWorksSubtitle: Four simple steps to turn any reference into a professional prompt ready for AI video generation.
home.howItWorksPlaceholder: Describe the video you want to analyze...
home.howItWorksStep1Desc: Upload a video, image, or audio file, or paste an online link.
home.howItWorksStep2Desc: AI parses the reference and extracts key visual and audio elements.
home.howItWorksStep3Desc: Adjust prompt details like style, aspect ratio, and camera motion.
home.howItWorksStep4Desc: Export the prompt in one click or jump straight into generation and editing.
home.testimonial1Quote: Prompt Lens turned our reference videos into Sora-ready prompts and saved us hours of trial and error.
home.testimonial2Quote: The audio-to-prompt feature is a game changer for music videos and ads where rhythm needs to match the visuals.
home.testimonial3Quote: Since the team started managing prompt templates in Prompt Lens, our brand videos have become much more consistent.
home.faq1Q: What video formats does PromptLens support?
home.faq1A: We support mainstream video formats including MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, WebM, as well as JPG, PNG, and WebP images.
home.faq2Q: Do I need to configure an API key?
home.faq2A: To use all features, add your own KIE API key in settings. The two free video analysis trials use the platform OpenRouter Gemini model; user-provided OpenRouter keys are not supported.
home.faq3Q: What model is used for video generation?
home.faq3A: Video generation runs through KIE models, including text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-video generation, and Wan video editing. Credits are charged by model and duration.
home.faq4A: Yes. History records can be exported as TXT, Markdown, and JSON for easy organization and reuse of prompts.
home.faq5A: Yes. Prompt templates, history, and settings are stored in the cloud and sync across devices when logged into the same account.

home.pricingSubtitle: New accounts get 2 credits for two free video analyses. Bring your own KIE key for all platform features, or buy the creation pack to use platform KIE for video generation.
home.pricingFreeDesc: New accounts get 2 credits. No API key required for trying single-shot video analysis under 10 seconds.
home.pricingFreeBullet1: 2 credits included for each new account
home.pricingFreeBullet2: Only supports complete shots under 10 seconds
home.pricingFreeBullet3: Best for validating analysis quality first
home.pricingByokDesc: New accounts get 2 credits for two single-shot analyses under 10 seconds. Add your own KIE key and all platform features run on your KIE quota.
home.pricingByokBullet1: 2 signup credits for two free video analyses
home.pricingByokBullet2: Free trials are locked to OpenRouter Gemini 2.5 Flash
home.pricingByokBullet3: KIE keys unlock video analysis, generation, audio, and editing
home.pricingLongDesc: Unlock long-video upload and auto shot splitting for BYOK users. Model calls still use your own API key.
home.pricingLongBullet2: Covers worker, upload, storage, and job processing
home.pricingLongBullet3: Does not include model analysis costs
home.pricingStandardDesc: No API key required. Platform covers model calls for regular creators.
home.pricingStandardBullet2: About 3 long videos with 20 shots each
home.pricingProDesc: For users analyzing reference videos, ads, and content libraries in batches.
home.pricingProBullet2: About 9 long videos with 20 shots each
home.pricingProBullet3: AI script rewriting is free for high-volume use
home.pricingCreationDesc: For analyzing a shot and generating a same-style video right after. Includes platform KIE video analysis and video generation credits.
home.pricingCreationBullet1: About 12-20 groups of 1 shot analysis + 1 video generation
home.pricingCreationBullet2: Video generation is charged by model and duration; regular 8-10s clips cost about 12-30 credits
home.pricingCreationBullet3: For creators who want to use platform quota without configuring KIE
home.pricingRulesTitle: Short clips by shot, long videos by split result
home.pricingRulesDesc: Long videos are split into shots first, then charged by analyzed shot count. This keeps pricing aligned with model usage, worker processing, and storage cost.
home.pricingRuleShortDesc: Single-shot video under 10 seconds: 1 credit. Free trial and BYOK free mode only support this upload type.
home.pricingRuleLongDesc: Auto-splitting base fee: 3 credits + 1 credit per shot. A 20-shot long video costs about 23 credits.
home.pricingRuleScopeDesc: Video analysis credits are only spent on shot analysis; the creation pack can be used for platform KIE video generation. AI script rewriting is free. Audio generation and editing will be priced separately.
